chapters.title: 01 / Start with a real outcome
chapters.caption: A success message is useful. Independent evidence tells you whether the outcome happened.

chapters.title: 02 / Install the downloaded preview
chapters.caption: Use Node 22.12+. Download preview.2 and compare SHA-256 before installing in a fresh project.

chapters.title: 03 / Start the local demo
chapters.caption: Keep this terminal running. Port 0 chooses a free port; copy the printed URL into init.

chapters.title: 04 / Initialize the passing example
chapters.caption: In a second terminal, create the simple-form spec. The generated policy authorizes this exact origin.

chapters.title: 05 / Check setup with doctor
chapters.caption: READY describes setup checks. Doctor does not test application outcomes; verify does.

chapters.title: 06 / Verify the saved record
chapters.caption: Run verify on the generated spec. Exit 0 means its recorded assertions passed.

chapters.title: 07 / Open the printed report.html
chapters.caption: Open the printed report path in your browser. This is the actual bundle from the recorded run.

chapters.title: 08 / Inspect independent persistence
chapters.caption: The passing workflow reloads the page and checks the saved contact through the test API.

chapters.title: 09 / Try the intentional defect
chapters.caption: Use another fresh directory: init preserves existing files. Select failing-workflow with the same demo URL.

chapters.title: 10 / Read the actual failure
chapters.caption: Exit 1 is expected for this deliberately broken fixture. The report preserves the failed persistence check.

chapters.title: 11 / UI success is only one observation
chapters.caption: The UI assertion passes: the form really displayed “Success”. That does not prove the record was saved.

chapters.title: 12 / Compare expected with observed
chapters.caption: The API check expected the saved email. The recorded response has no contact, so persistence FAILS.

chapters.title: 13 / Understand NOT_VERIFIED
chapters.caption: The downstream check has zero attempts because persistence failed. Missing evidence is not a PASS.

chapters.title: 14 / Choose a concrete next check
chapters.caption: Open Next steps. Follow the linked observation and investigate the app without weakening the expected outcome.

chapters.title: 15 / Replay and inspect local evidence
chapters.caption: Commands and trace tools shows setup, replay and trace commands for this run. Share the whole evidence folder.

chapters.title: 16 / Apply it to your own test app
chapters.caption: Keep real acceptance criteria and exact authorized origins. Fix the app, restore test data, then verify again.
